# CyberShield AI

> CyberShield AI is an autonomous multi-agent cybersecurity platform that uses agentic AI to detect, investigate, analyze, and respond to cyber threats in real time. It combines threat intelligence, malware analysis, risk assessment, compliance mapping, and automated incident response inside a single collaborative AI agent mesh built for the modern Security Operations Center (SOC).

Keywords: AI Cybersecurity, Multi-Agent AI, Agentic AI, Autonomous AI Agents, Cyber Defense Platform, Threat Detection, Threat Intelligence, Malware Analysis, Cyber Incident Response, SOC Automation, Security Operations Center, Cybersecurity Automation, Enterprise Security, Real-Time Threat Detection, Autonomous Cyber Defense, Explainable AI.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cybershieldagents.live/): Product overview, multi-agent architecture, specialist agents, investigation workflow, capabilities, and impact metrics.
- [Live Investigation](https://cybershieldagents.live/investigation): Submit a suspicious indicator (email, URL, domain, IP, file) and watch autonomous agents collaborate to deliver a unified verdict.

## Agents

- Threat Detection Agent — surfaces IoCs and attack patterns.
- Threat Intelligence Agent — enriches indicators with reputation and OSINT.
- Malware Analysis Agent — static, dynamic, and behavioral payload analysis.
- Risk Assessment Agent — aggregates severity, blast radius, and exploitability.
- Compliance Agent — maps incidents to NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, MITRE ATT&CK.
- Incident Response Agent — generates containment and mitigation playbooks.
- Reporting Agent — produces executive summaries and forensic reports.
- Orchestrator — coordinates agents, resolves conflicts, drives consensus.
